hypothesis.statement: The discriminant separating the shape-V members that respond to declaration order from those that do not is WHICH SIDE lowers the @lo in place. clause (b) of claim.law.pointer-decl-order-flips-addrlo-inplace-vs-fresh-destination describes ours-IN-PLACE / target-FRESH, and move_logic22 is exactly that -- ours `@0x164 addi r3,r3,0 @sMilestones(ADDR16_LO)`, target `@0x164 addi r4,r3,0 @sMilestones(ADDR16_LO)` -- and it responded. _AdsThread is the MIRROR -- ours `@0x2c addi r3,r4,0 <gADS>` (fresh) followed by the copy `@0x30 addi r4,r3,0`, against a target that lowers into r4 in place and pays no copy at all -- and it did not respond. The next lane should test this on ProcessCritterList, the one untried row carrying the responsive polarity, and treat the two mirror rows (check_prefs_loaded, setup_vmu_entries) as predicted non-responders whose falsification would be equally informative.
